asset_selection.rule: user-selected fixed instruments; no survivorship-free universe claim
asset_selection.accounts: one independent USD account per instrument; no cross-asset portfolio
asset_selection.data_requirements: complete XNYS regular sessions for stocks; observed Dukascopy bid/ask candles for FX, with crossed quotes quarantined
asset_selection.survivorship: a fixed list chosen in advance; not a survivorship-free sample

liquidity_filters.measured_on: the 63 bars before the validation end, all known before the test embargo
liquidity_filters.stocks: median raw close >= min_median_price, median close x volume >= min_median_dollar_volume, fold capital / median dollar volume <= max_participation
liquidity_filters.fx: both currencies in fx_currencies with USD on one side, observed bid/ask quotes
liquidity_filters.on_failure: the instrument-year is not traded or evaluated

decision_schedule.bar: one daily bar per session: XNYS regular session for stocks (09:30-16:00 ET, early closes respected); UTC calendar day for FX
decision_schedule.signal_calculation_time: at the bar's available_at (stocks: the session close; FX: 00:00 UTC after the candle), from bars whose available_at is at or before it
decision_schedule.execution_time: the next bar's open, and only if that open is at or after the signal bar's available_at; stocks fill at the next 09:30 ET open with spread and slippage, FX buys at the next candle's first ask and sells at its first bid

delay.fx: none after the candle completes: the next candle's first quote at 00:00 UTC is assumed executable

decision_schedule.exit_monitoring: targets, stops and holding deadlines are checked at each close and filled at the next open; no intrabar fills
decision_schedule.retraining_time: once per test year, before its first session

admissible_information.point_in_time_rule: a decision at bar t uses only rows with available_at <= available_at(t); cross-market features use a backward as-of join with a finite maximum age; lags and rolling windows are never backfilled

moo3.detail: SMA, CCI, RSI and Williams %R over 10-50 bars; ATR and EMA over 3-10 bars; scale-free OBV change over 20 bars; directional-change statistics over 3-50 calendar days

mstgam.detail: directional-change state machines at ten fixed thresholds; no fixed window

igtsp_ring.detail: 21 TA-Lib rules; longest warm-up TRIX(30) = 88 bars, then MACD(12,26,9) = 33 and ADX(14) = 27

feature_lookbacks.recursive_state: EMA, Wilder RSI/ATR/ADX, OBV, Parabolic SAR and directional-change trend state are recursive: they start at the fold's training start and run forward, so a test-year decision depends on every bar from the training start up to the decision bar and on none after it

data_publication_lags.stock_ohlcv: known at the session close (available_at = XNYS close); no further vendor delay is modeled
data_publication_lags.fx_ohlc: known at 00:00 UTC after the candle (available_at = open + 1 day)
data_publication_lags.splits: applied on the effective date; later split factors only undo the vendor's back-adjustment of earlier prices (regression-tested) and are never features
data_publication_lags.dividends: cash entitlement on the ex-date open; adjusted closes are not used

admissible_information.fit_time_information: scalers, directional-change thresholds and triggers, and the Ring rule bank are fitted on training rows only; configuration choice uses validation rows only; test rows are never used to fit or select
excluded: FX volume (not consolidated); volume rules leave the Ring pool
any row after the decision bar
admissible_information.reporting_only: annualization factors count bars per year over the whole dataset; they scale reported statistics and never enter fitting or selection

score_to_trade_mapping.signal_alphabet: +1 buy: enter long if flat; -1 sell: exit if long; 0: no action

entry.moo3: buy when the evolved Boolean rule tree is true at the close
entry.mstgam: buy when the buy side wins the weighted vote of 70 directional-change genes (hurdle: min_votes 2, min_votes 3)
entry.igtsp_ring: each sleeve buys when its TA-Lib buy rule fires

exit.moo3: holding deadline of 5 calendar days, or a +5% target observed at a close; no sell rule
exit.mstgam: sell when the sell side wins the vote
exit.igtsp_ring: the sleeve's sell rule, or an evolved take-profit in [0, 10%] or stop-loss in [0, 10%] observed at a close
exit.all: filled at the next open; a position still open at a window's last close is liquidated there with exit costs (sample_end)

sizing.rule: all allocated capital in fractional units at the fill price after costs
sizing.moo3_mstgam: one position using the fold's whole capital
sizing.igtsp_ring: capital split across groups by the evolved weights (equal weights in robust profiles), equally among each group's members, fixed for the year

no_trade_state: signal 0 keeps the current state; a flat account stays in cash earning nothing
during indicator warm-up, undefined features never trigger
bars between weekly or monthly decision bars emit no action
conflicting Ring buy and sell rules hold
when no configuration has >= 2 validation trades, the method holds cash for the whole test year
an instrument-year that fails the liquidity screen is not traded

risk_constraints.exposure_limits: gross exposure <= 100% of fold equity; no pyramiding; Ring sleeve allocations fixed at the fold start with no rebalancing or borrowing between sleeves
risk_constraints.concentration: 100% in one instrument per account by design; Ring diversifies only across rules on that instrument
risk_constraints.liquidity_participation: order <= 1% of median session dollar volume (stocks)
risk_constraints.stops: only Ring evolves stop losses; no account drawdown stop, volatility target or kill switch

spreads.fx: observed bid/ask: buy at ask, sell at bid

other_costs.fx_financing_source: primary: zero carry (sign of historical carry not modeled); stress: 2%/yr debit on held notional
other_costs.dividends: credited on the ex-date, no withholding tax
other_costs.market_impact: not modeled; relies on the participation cap

stress_scenario.models: the same frozen strategies; nothing is refitted

cost_model.applied_in: training fitness, validation, test and the buy-and-hold baseline, through one engine

evaluation.scheme: rolling walk-forward on calendar years: train, embargo, validation, embargo, test
evaluation.training_window: 3 calendar years before the validation year, minus the embargo
evaluation.validation_window: 1 calendar year before the test year, minus the embargo
evaluation.test_window: one complete calendar year; every fold starts flat with fresh capital
evaluation.retraining_frequency: annual: a fresh fit per method, seed and test year; deployed model: the validated training-only model

label_horizon.definition: bars from a decision to the end of the return it earns in fitness or validation
label_horizon.mstgam: unbounded until a sell vote; truncated at the window end
label_horizon.igtsp_ring: unbounded until a sell rule, target or stop; truncated at the window end
label_horizon.daily_fitness: one bar for marked-to-market daily fitness (robust profiles)

max_feature_lookback.recursive_state: EMA, Wilder RSI/ATR/ADX, OBV, Parabolic SAR and directional-change trend state are recursive: they start at the fold's training start and run forward, so a test-year decision depends on every bar from the training start up to the decision bar and on none after it
max_feature_lookback.check: training windows must exceed it (warmup_ok in fold_audit)

purging.method: label truncation at every window boundary
purging.rule: fit receives only rows before the training end and validation scores only validation rows; positions open at a window's last close are liquidated there, so no training or validation label ends after its window
purging.why_not_fixed_width: MSTGAM and Ring holding periods are unbounded (p95 12-85 bars, maximum a full year in the audited2 runs), so a fixed purge would remove a year

embargo.unit: weekday trading sessions; FX Sunday stubs are merged first
embargo.covers: the one-bar execution delay and MOO3's maximum holding period
embargo.check: counted per fold in fold_audit; a shorter gap stops the run
